# Homesite Mortgage

> Family-owned Florida mortgage broker, licensed statewide since 1999. NMLS #353790. Based at 2754 Aurora Road, Melbourne, FL 32935 (Brevard County / Space Coast). A real, licensed person handles every loan — not a call center. Purchase, refinance, FHA, VA, conventional, DSCR, and non-QM home loans across all of Florida. Rated 5.0 from 28 verified Google reviews.

## About
Homesite Mortgage Corporation is a Florida-licensed mortgage brokerage (NMLS #353790) serving borrowers statewide. Family-owned and operated since 1999, the firm is known for personal service: a small team of licensed professionals guides each borrower from application to closing. As a broker, Homesite shops each loan across multiple lenders rather than offering the products of a single institution — Homesite does not itself approve or fund loans.

## Not to be confused with
Homesite Mortgage Corporation of Melbourne, Florida is **not affiliated** with Homesite Direct or homesitedirect.com, which is an unrelated company with a similar name. The distinguishing identifier is NMLS #353790, verifiable at https://www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org

## Important notes
- Licensed in Florida only. Equal Housing Opportunity.
- Homesite Mortgage is a mortgage BROKER, not a lender. It does not approve or fund loans.
- This is not a commitment to lend; all loans are subject to credit approval and underwriting.
- No rates, APRs, payments, or fees are published on this site. Those depend on the individual file and are provided in writing after review.
- Verify licensing at https://www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org
